title: OpenMods support for one harness
description: mods/<owner>/<name>/<harness>/support.json: the harness release the mod's patches are for, and the patches.

ref.description: The harness release the patches are for, e.g. v1.18.32. This is the mod's version on this harness; CI moves it forward when the patches still apply and typecheck on a newer release.

conflicts.description: Mods, as owner/name, known not to work together with this one on this harness.
